title: "tables"

# Packages Used
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
```


# Loading Results
```{r}
var <- read_csv("var_results.csv")
out <- read_csv("outlier_results.csv")
miss <- read_csv("missing_data_results.csv")
```


# Selecting Data
```{r}
# Variance
var_table <- var |>
  filter(dataset == "Normal") |>
  mutate(
    Condition = recode(
      variance,
      "Homogeneous" = "Homoskedastic",
      "Heterogeneous mean" = "Prop to Mean",
      "Heterogeneous block" = "Prop to Block"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Condition, type1_error, mean_F, var_F, mean_R2) |>
  mutate(type1_error = 100 * type1_error)

# Outliers
out_table <- out |>
  filter(pi == 0 | pi == 0.05 | pi == 0.10) |>
  mutate(
    Distribution = recode(
      outlier_condition,
      "Normal outliers" = "Normal",
      "Constant outliers" = "Constant",
      "Cauchy outliers" = "Cauchy"
    ),
    Distribution = factor(
      Distribution,
      levels = c("Normal", "Constant", "Cauchy")
    ),
    type1_error = 100 * type1_error
  ) |>
  arrange(Distribution, pi) |>
  select(Distribution, pi, type1_error, mean_F, var_F, mean_R2)

# Missing Data
miss_table <- miss |>
  mutate(
    Method = recode(
      method,
      "Complete data" = "Complete",
      "Mean imputation" = "Mean Imputation",
      "Linear imputation" = "Linear Imputation"
    ),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Complete",
        "Mean Imputation",
        "CMIB",
        "CMIT",
        "Linear Imputation"
      )
    ),
    type1_error = 100 * type1_error
  ) |>
  arrange(Method) |>
  select(Method, type1_error, mean_F, var_F, mean_R2)
```


# Generating Tables
```{r}
# Variance table
var_latex <- kable(
  var_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  digits = 2,
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Condition",
    "Type I (\\%)",
    "Mean $F$",
    "Var $F$",
    "Mean $R^2$"
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
)

# Outlier table
out_latex <- kable(
  out_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  digits = 2,
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Outlier Dist.",
    "$\\pi$",
    "Type I (\\%)",
    "Mean $F$",
    "Var $F$",
    "Mean $R^2$"
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
)

# Missing data table
miss_latex <- kable(
  miss_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  linesep = "",
  digits = 2,
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Method",
    "Type I (\\%)",
    "Mean $F$",
    "Var $F$",
    "Mean $R^2$"
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")
)
```
